original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚陆军炮兵部队寻求本土技术以提升联合火力支援能力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚陆军炮兵部队在卡杜纳州卡奇亚举行2026年“火神训练期/火神之光XII”学习期，主题为优化炮兵在联合与多域作战中的决定性火力支援能力。退役少将Jokotola呼吁深化本土研究、技术与专业训练，并强调尼日利亚陆军必须发展本土解决方案。炮兵司令Adeyemo表示正与本土技术公司合作改进炮兵平台，并计划在10月16日进行火力演示。

location.site: 尼日利亚陆军炮兵学校

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚陆军炮兵部队在卡杜纳州卡奇亚举行2026年火神训练期学习活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: at the 2026 Vulcan Training Period/Exercise Vulcan Glow XII Study Period in Kachia, Kaduna State, on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 退役少将Jokotola呼吁深化本土研究、技术与专业训练以提升联合火力支援能力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigerian Army Corps of Artillery has been urged to deepen indigenous research, technology and professional training to enhance its capacity for effective fire support in joint and multi-domain operations

key_facts.fact: 炮兵司令Adeyemo表示正与本土技术公司合作改进炮兵平台
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the corps was also strengthening research and development through partnerships with indigenous technical companies to improve artillery platforms and equipment

key_facts.fact: 火力演示计划于10月16日举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: scheduled to culminate in an artillery firepower demonstration on Oct. 16
